summary.en: Ran receives an anonymous "love" letter that has Conan worried. Ran isn't able to decide if she should go meet this person or not. Then Ran, Conan, and Sonoko help a lady whom had a strange break-in in her home which then eventually leads to saving a man's life. Location: Tono household The thief broke in, took some money from an envelope, read her diary, moved her deceased husband's urn a little, and then put the money back before leaving.
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。
